title: Token gating & backpressure regression suite for constrained-decoder in streaming JSON mode
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Purpose: build a focused regression + CI test suite to validate token-level gating, backpressure behavior, and schema adherence when the constrained decoder operates in streaming JSON mode. Scope includes: unit mocks for token gating hooks, integration tests that exercise partial JSON emissions under simulated network stalls, and end-to-end scenarios comparing parserable JSON output against gold schemas under heavy load and intentional perturbations. This ticket emphasizes detecting silent schema violations (partial tokens, truncated arrays/objects, stray commas) and verifying recovery/fallbacks when the runtime must stall or re-request tokens due to rate limits or kernel backoffs.
acceptance_criteria: CI runs include a new job 'constrained-decoder-stream-regress' that executes on PRs affecting streaming or decoder subsystems
At least 120 deterministic test vectors (12 schemas x 10 load/noise variants) pass with zero schema-violation regressions in nominal runs

Simulated backpressure scenarios produce documented fallback behavior: either graceful partial object flushing (with last_key marker) or deterministic retry policy; metrics and logs show a <0.1% unhandled-json-error rate
Token gating thresholds validated: when global token-limiter is hit, constrained-decoder must not emit mid-token characters that break JSON tokens
Test harness produces machine-readable artifacts: per-test schema diff, token streams, and parsing error histogram uploaded to the artifacts dashboard
test_plan: Deterministic unit tests: mock TokenGating layer to assert that when gate returns 'pause', decoder halts before emitting any incomplete UTF-8/JSON tokens
Integration: local full-stack run with the runtime binary + streaming proxy; inject network delays and token rate caps; verify final assembled stream parses with the golden schema
Stress matrix: 12 schemas (flat JSON, nested objects, arrays of objects, mixed types) x 10 noise profiles (latency spikes, truncated chunks, corrupted bytes, out-of-order fragments)
Chaos scenarios: intermittent K/V cache eviction mid-stream, forced kernel-switch during streaming, and sudden model fallback to a smaller variant—verify schema adherence or safe fallback signaling
Golden replay: capture real customer-like traces (sanitized) and replay them through the harness to ensure no regression vs baseline runtime-1.18
